# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server running the gsc probe
# client-probes/probe_fxontag.gsc on mp_carentan; this probe joined allies, weapon m1carbine_mp, role fx.
# Three shells, the server first, then the two probes, the order the roles join in:
#   COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PORT=<p> SECS=<s> \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/<probe> <map>
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:<p> --probe-team <team> \
#       --save-scripted <role> --probe-secs <s>
# The gsc probe's header has the teams, roles and times.
# One !gamestate per gamestate, one !cmd per serverCommand verbatim, a !sound after
# each `s` with the alias it names, and one !trace per snapshot whose rendering
# moved plus one a second (vcod_common::net::capture::trace_body has the format).
# ms is since the probe started. The probe sends `score` every 2 s, so every `b`
# here was asked for.
!gamestate ms=969 serverId=16 mapname=mp_carentan
